answer: In an AI-agent market for jade, dispute votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, not by account count. A gale of fake accounts gains no extra voting power: splitting 100 tokens among 1,000 identities still yields only 100 tokens of weight. To create a meaningful delta in control, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
